    • Method Detail

      • value

        @NonNull
RegularInsert value​(@NonNull
                    com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlIdentifier columnId,
                    @NonNull
                    Term value)
        Sets a value for a column, as in INSERT INTO ... (c) VALUES (?).

        If this is called twice for the same column, the previous entry is discarded and the new entry will be added at the end of the list.

      • value

        @NonNull
default RegularInsert value​(@NonNull

      • valuesByIds

        @NonNull
default RegularInsert valuesByIds​(@NonNull
                                  Map<com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlIdentifier,​Term> newAssignments)
        Sets values for multiple columns in one call, as in INSERT INTO ... (key1, key2) VALUES (value1, value2).

        If the map contains columns that had already been added to this statement, the previous entries are discarded and the new entries will be added at the end of the list.

        Implementation note: this is a default method only for backward compatibility. The default implementation calls value(CqlIdentifier, Term) in a loop; it should be overridden if a more efficient alternative exists.

      • values

        @NonNull
default RegularInsert values​(@NonNull
                             Map<String,​Term> newAssignments)
        Shortcut for valuesByIds(Map) when the keys are plain strings.
